title: 台積電 CoWoS 整合案例
summary: 從CoWoS 變體、中介層、HBM 與封裝整合拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate CoWoS variants, interposers, HBM and package integration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設有效直線互連邊長 10 mm、單列節距 50 µm，理想位置數 floor(10000/50)=200。若教學預留40個供電/接地、20個備用，最多140個訊號位置。此一維上限未包含多列、禁佈區和布線可達性，不是 CoWoS 公開或保密的實際節距。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 10 mm effective shoreline and 50 µm single-row pitch: floor(10000/50)=200 positions. Reserving 40 for power/ground and 20 spare leaves at most 140 signals. This 1D bound excludes multiple rows, keepouts and routability and is not a CoWoS process pitch.
workedExample.assumptions: 假想一維幾何，只用來練習介面預算；實際設計須取得供應商平台規則。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Hypothetical 1D geometry for interface budgeting; real design requires supplier platform rules.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.
